quote: all those brain memory are maintained by the actual intent flow lifecycles right? so it also traces which step did when what and how right?
means: Every write to brain is an event of an intent's lifecycle. The event records when, who, what and how, and which docs it wrote; the step is the one the intent stood at, computed from the events before it. A doc's trace is the event that wrote it.
